title: ld.lld - Invalid operand divq $-4611686018427387904
body:
### Tested versions

4.5 branch

### System information

Gentoo 2.18 on Tty - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 680M (radeonsi, rembrandt, LLVM 20.1.8, DRM 3.64, 6.17.1-gentoo) - AMD Ryzen 7 6800H with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 30.53 GiB memory

### Issue description

Compilation succeeded, but there is a linker error:
```
ld.lld: error: ld-temp.o <inline asm>:1:7: invalid operand for instruction
        divq $-4611686018427387904
             ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~


ld.lld: error: ld-temp.o <inline asm>:1:7: invalid operand for instruction
        divq $-4611686018427387904
             ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

clang++: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
```

### Steps to reproduce

Clone Godot branch 4.5:
```shell
 git clone --verbose --recursive --depth=1 --branch 4.5 https://github.com/godotengine/godot.git
```

Start the compilation with:
```shell
scons platform=linuxbsd target=template_release optimize=speed lto=full disable_3d=yes disable_physics_2d=yes disable_physics_3d=yes disable_navigation_2d=yes disable_navigation_3d=yes disable_xr=yes
modules_enabled_by_default=no touch=no module_basis_universal_enabled=yes module_etcpak_enabled=yes module_freetype_enabled=yes module_gdscript_enabled=yes module_glslang_enabled=yes module_jpg_enabled=yes module_png_enabled=yes module_svg_enabled=yes module_text_server_adv_enabled=yes module_webp_enabled=yes module_zip_enabled=yes alsa=no pulseaudio=no
use_llvm=yes use_static_cpp=no linkflags="-Wl,-O2 -Wl,--as-needed" ccflags="-flto=full -O3 -march=native -mtune=native
-pipe -fPIC" builtin_zstd=no builtin_zlib=no builtin_libpng=no builtin_libjpeg_turbo=no builtin_icu4c=no builtin_harfbuzz=no builtin_freetype=no builtin_graphite=no builtin_brotli=no
```
